verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a skills bundle for agent-assisted work. Its closest feature, the Ralph loop, executes 'exactly one explicitly assigned' Ledger task to a queued commit. That is a one-off, user-initiated action, not a recurring schedule, trigger, or background automation. Nothing in the pack documents autonomous background runs, schedules, or event-triggered automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
